title: ゆらぐな石垣
concept: 形のちがう石を積んで石垣を築き、天端に城をのせて地震を耐えさせる。石は積み山のすぐ上に浮いて「置く」感覚で、城をのせる前に水平か傾くかが見える。高さ・平らさ・横の広がりの釣り合いが核。
howToPlay: 指を左右に動かして石の位置を決め、はなすと置ける。金の線まで積んだら城をのせ、地震で城が残れば落成。
libraryDecision: matter-js を使用。石のかみ合わせと地震での崩れ方そのものが遊びなので物理演算が核に直結する。再考で、地震は土台を動かす代わりに横向きの重力を揺らす方式にして、積み方の良し悪しが素直に結果に出るようにした。ZzFX で音も作った。
soundDecision: 石が当たるたびに強さに応じた「コツ」という石音、地震の低い地鳴り、落成の三音を ZzFX で鳴らす。BGM は入れず、石の音と静けさで積む集中と地震の緊張を際立たせた。

improvements.found: 石が小さく数も足りず金の線に届かない／高い所から落とすので跳ねて転がる／あとどれだけ積めばいいか分からない
improvements.changed: 石を積み山のすぐ上に自動で浮かせ、指は左右だけで「置く」操作に。石を大きく数を増やし、線の横に「あと何m」を表示
improvements.foundEn: Stones too small and few to reach the line / dropped from high they bounce and roll / no sense of how much is left
improvements.changedEn: The stone now hovers right above the pile and the finger only sets x, so you place rather than drop. Bigger and more stones, and a "m to go" label by the line

improvements.found: 城を低い所に置くと即失敗し理由が分からない／1面の弱い地震でも丸い石の山が全部崩れる／失敗画面に手がかりがない
improvements.changed: 石を角ばった切石中心に変え、静止した石は眠らせて崩れにくく。地震は横向きの重力の揺れにして面ごとに強める。城を置ける高さを判定し、低いと置けない表示に。失敗画面にコツを表示
improvements.foundEn: Placing the castle low failed instantly with no reason / even the mild stage-1 quake collapsed piles of round stones / the fail screen gave no clue
improvements.changedEn: Mostly squared cut stones, resting stones sleep so piles hold. The quake is a swinging sideways gravity that ramps per stage. Castle height is checked and refused when too low. Tips on the fail screen

improvements.found: 城が傾いた石の上でずり落ちても、置く前に分からない／1面を4回続けて失敗し心が折れる／地震がどれくらい強いか分からない
improvements.changed: 城をつるした時に「◎水平／△かたむく／低い！」を予告。城を軽く幅広にし1面の地震を弱め、回転を15度刻みに。各面に震度を表示
improvements.foundEn: The castle slid off tilted stones with no warning beforehand / failing stage 1 four times in a row was discouraging / the quake strength was unknown
improvements.changedEn: While hanging, the castle shows Level / Will tilt / Too low. Lighter, wider castle, gentler stage-1 quake, 15° rotation steps. Each stage shows its quake intensity

en.title: Steady Stones
en.concept: Stack odd-shaped stones into a castle wall, crown it with a castle, and make it survive an earthquake. Stones hover just above the pile so you place them, and before placing the castle you see whether it will sit level. The core is balancing height, flatness and width.
en.howToPlay: Move your finger left and right to position a stone and release to place it. Reach the gold line, place the castle, and if it survives the quake it is built.
en.libraryDecision: Uses matter-js: how stones interlock and how they crumble in a quake is the game itself. On rethinking, the quake swings a sideways gravity instead of shaking the ground, so good and bad stacking show honestly in the result. ZzFX for sound.
en.soundDecision: ZzFX stone clacks scaled by impact, a low rumble for the quake and a three-note chime when built. No BGM: the stone sounds and quiet sharpen the focus of stacking and the tension of the quake.

aiReview.worst: 物理の積み山が思ったより崩れやすく、1面でも何度も城が落ちる。崩れた理由が分かりにくい時がある
aiReview.comment: 石が積み山のすぐ上に浮いて置ける操作は分かりやすく、角石がかみ合うと石垣らしくなる。◎水平の所に城をのせて地震を耐え『落成！』が出た瞬間は気持ちよかった。ただそこまでに細い塔や傾いた石で5回ほど落とし、初見では楽しくなる前に挫けそう。

similar.note_en: Stacking wobbly physics blocks. Here you place at your own pace rather than falling pieces, and an earthquake comes at the end

aiReview.research: WebSearch で stacking stones physics game earthquake castle tower を検索

en.worst: The physics piles crumble more easily than expected; the castle fell several times even on stage 1, and the reason is sometimes unclear
en.comment: Placing stones that hover just above the pile is easy to grasp, and interlocking blocks start to look like a real castle wall. Placing the castle on a Level spot and seeing Built! after the quake felt great. But I dropped the castle about five times first, from narrow towers and tilted stones; a newcomer may give up before it gets fun.
